## Parameters

```{r}
###
### SOIL PARAMETERS
###

rd <- function(N_flux, u_max) {
  N_flux / u_max
}

# Example usage
N_flux <- 1.65  # or whatever effective flux you define
u_c <- 0.88     # kg N m^-2 year^-1
u_c_B <- 44      # kg N kg-1 year-1
rd_val <- rd(N_flux, u_c)

depth = 0.5

###
### ROOT PARAMETERS
###

# Average biomass when needed
B_root_average = 2.8      # kg
B_myco_average = 2.8      # kg

# TODO: go through an replace these!

# ECM defaults (replace with literature)
myco_diameter <- 1e-5     # m (8 microns - within observed range)
myco_density  <- 330      # kg m-3

# Root architecture
n <- 2.75e6                  # number of roots per crown area
l <- 1.5                  # average root length (mm or m depending on your model)

###
### EXTRA PARAMETERS
###

k9 <- 0.01                # nitrogen gate parameter
k8 <- 2.7                 # uptake-age parameter (years)

C_r = 2
A_c = C_r^2 * pi

k20 <- 2
# TODO: fit this!
k21 <- 0.1

mycorrhized   <- 0.9      # 90% colonisation
investment_m  <- 0.2      # fungi return 30% of N to host

traits <- list(
  k_1 = 0.25,      # diameter scaling (mm * sqrt(m))  → adjust for your species
  k_2 = 0.15,      # cortex scaling 1
  k_3 = 0.02,      # cortex scaling 2
  k_4 = 350,       # cortical density (kg m-3)
  k_5 = 150,       # stele density (kg m-3)
  k_6 = 3,         # max lifespan (years)
  k_7 = 3,         # lifespan sensitivity to diameter
  k_9 = 0.01,                # nitrogen gate parameter
  k_8 = 2.7                 # uptake-age parameter (years)
)


```

## Equtaions

```{r}

############################################################
## ROOT ARCHITECTURE FUNCTIONS
############################################################

root_lifespan(1:4, traits)

root_diameter <- function(root_length, traits) {
  traits$k_1 / sqrt(root_length)
}

root_density <- function(root_length, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  pct_cortex <- (traits$k_2 + traits$k_3 / d)^2
  traits$k_4 * pct_cortex + traits$k_5
}

root_lifespan <- function(root_length, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  traits$k_6 * (1 - exp(-traits$k_7 * d))
}

root_mass <- function(root_length, root_no, crown_area, traits) {
  d <- root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  rho <- root_density(root_length, traits)
  rho * (d/2)^2 * root_length * pi * root_no * 1e-9 * crown_area
}

############################################################
## DEPLETION RADIUS
############################################################

rd <- function(N_s, D, u_max) {
  N_s * D / u_max
}

############################################################
## SOIL EXPLORATION PER BIOMASS
############################################################

e_u_root <- function(r_d, root_diameter_mm, root_density) {
  d_m <- root_diameter_mm / 1000
  4 * r_d^2 / (root_density * d_m^2)
}

e_u_myco <- function(r_d, myco_diameter_m, myco_density) {
  4 * r_d^2 / (myco_density * myco_diameter_m^2)
}

############################################################
## CROWDING SATURATION FUNCTION
############################################################

S_crowding <- function(B_root, B_myco,
                       root_d_mm, myco_diameter,
                       rho_root, rho_myco,
                       D, N_s, u_max,
                       C_r = 2, depth = 0.5,
                       k20 = 2, k21 = 1) {
  
  # --- Compute depletion radius ---
  rd <- D * N_s / u_max
  
  # --- Compute soil explored per unit biomass ---
  d_root_m <- root_d_mm / 1000  # convert mm -> m
  e_root <- 4 * rd^2 / (rho_root * d_root_m^2)
  e_myco <- 4 * rd^2 / (rho_myco * myco_diameter^2)
  
  # --- Ellipsoid soil volume ---
  V_soil <- (4/3) * pi * (k20 * C_r)^2 * depth
  
  # --- Free soil volume corrected for porosity and existing biomass ---
  V_free <- k21 * V_soil - B_root / rho_root - B_myco / rho_myco
  
  # --- Total explored volume ---
  V_explored <- B_root * e_root + B_myco * e_myco
  
  # --- Saturation function ---
  S <- if (V_explored > V_free) {V_free/V_explored} else 1
  
  return(S)
}

############################################################
## ROOT AND MYCORRHIZAL UPTAKE
############################################################

uptake_core <- function(B_root, B_myco,
                        root_d_mm, myco_diameter,
                        rho_root, rho_myco,
                        D, N_s, u_max,
                        C_r = 2, depth = 0.5,
                        k20 = 2, k21 = 1, k23 = 1) {

  # --- Compute saturation factor (includes rd and e_root/e_myco internally) ---
  Sval <- S_crowding(B_root = B_root,
                     B_myco = B_myco,
                     root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
                     myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
                     rho_root = rho_root,
                     rho_myco = rho_myco,
                     D = D,
                     N_s = N_s,
                     u_max = u_max,
                     C_r = C_r,
                     depth = depth,
                     k20 = k20,
                     k21 = k21)
  
  # --- Compute depletion radius for reporting ---
  rd_val <- D * N_s / u_max
  
  # --- Compute soil explored per unit biomass ---
  d_root_m <- root_d_mm / 1000
  e_root <- 4 * rd_val^2 / (rho_root * d_root_m^2)
  e_myco <- 4 * rd_val^2 / (rho_myco * myco_diameter^2)
  
  # --- Final uptake ---
  U_root_c <- B_root * u_max * Sval
  U_myco_c <- B_myco * u_max * Sval
  
  U_s_root <- N_s * e_root / (N_s * e_root + k23)
  U_s_myco <- N_s * e_myco / (N_s * e_myco + k23)
  
  U_root <- U_root_c * U_s_root
  U_myco <- U_myco_c * U_s_myco
  
  # --- Return all relevant info ---
  list(
    U_root = U_root,
    U_myco = U_myco,
    Sval = Sval,
    rd = rd_val,
    e_root = e_root,
    e_myco = e_myco
  )
}


############################################################
## AGE EFFECT AND NITROGEN GATE
############################################################

uptake_age <- function(age, k8) {
  1 / (1 + exp(age - k8))
}

nitrogen_gate <- function(root_no, root_length, root_diameter) {
  SA <- root_no * pi * root_length * root_diameter
  SA / (SA + k9)  # k9 should be defined in traits/config
}


############################################################
## WHOLE-PLANT UPTAKE
############################################################
plant_uptake <- function(N_s, crown_area, root_length, root_no,
                         traits, mycorrhized, investment_from_tree,
                         myco_diameter, myco_density, depth = 0.5,
                         u_max, D, C_r = 2, k20 = 2, k21 = 1, k23 = 2, myco_true = TRUE) {
  
  # --- Root functions ----
  root_d_mm = root_diameter(root_length, traits)
  rho_root = root_density(root_length, traits)
  age = root_lifespan(root_length, traits)
  
  B_root = root_mass(root_length, root_no, crown_area, traits)
  
  # --- Core uptake calculation ---
  core <- uptake_core(
    B_root = B_root,
    B_myco = if (myco_true) B_root else 0,
    root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
    myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
    rho_root = rho_root,
    rho_myco = myco_density,
    D = D,
    N_s = N_s,
    u_max = u_max,
    C_r = C_r,
    depth = depth,
    k20 = k20,
    k21 = k21,
    k23 = k23
  )
  
  # --- Age effect ---
  age_factor <- uptake_age(age, traits$k_8)
  
  # --- Nitrogen gate effect ---
  
  gate <- nitrogen_gate(root_no, root_length, root_d_mm)  # or root_diameter(root_length, traits) if available
  
  # --- Combine root and myco contributions ---
  uptake_total <- age_factor * ((1 - mycorrhized) * core$U_root +
                                mycorrhized * gate * investment_from_tree * core$U_myco)
  
  # --- Return a list of all relevant info ---
  return(list(
    N_total = uptake_total,
    U_root = core$U_root,
    U_myco = core$U_myco,
    S = core$Sval,
    r_d = core$rd,
    e_root = core$e_root,
    e_myco = core$e_myco,
    age = age
  ))
}

```

## e_u plots

```{r}
# ===============================================================
# e_u plots (UPDATED: consistent with new rd formulation)
# ===============================================================

# Root and mycorrhizal traits
root_d  <- root_diameter(l, traits) / 1000    # m
root_rho <- root_density(l, traits)           # kg m^-3
myco_d  <- myco_diameter                      # m
myco_rho <- myco_density                      # kg m^-3

# Ranges
N_s_vals  <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)           # soil N concentration
D_vals    <- 10^seq(-7, -3, length.out = 5)        # transport efficiency
u_max_vals <- c(0.44, 0.88)                        # biochemical limits

# Compute values
df_eu <- expand_grid(
  N_s   = N_s_vals,
  D     = D_vals,
  u_max = u_max_vals
) %>%
  mutate(
    r_d = (D * N_s) / u_max,
    e_r = 4 * r_d^2 / (root_rho * root_d^2),
    e_m = 4 * r_d^2 / (myco_rho * myco_d^2),
    ratio = e_m / e_r,
    D = factor(D)
  )

p_root <- ggplot(df_eu, aes(N_s, e_r, colour = D)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Root Soil Exploration per Biomass",
    x = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
    y = expression(e[u]^r~"(m"^3~"kg"^{-1}*")"),
    colour = "D"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ u_max, labeller = label_bquote(u[max] == .(u_max))) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )


p_myco <- ggplot(df_eu, aes(N_s, e_m, colour = D)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Mycorrhizal Soil Exploration per Biomass",
    x = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
    y = expression(e[u]^m~"(m"^3~"kg"^{-1}*")"),
    colour = "D"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ u_max, labeller = label_bquote(u[max] == .(u_max))) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_rd <- ggplot(df_eu, aes(N_s, r_d, colour = D)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Depletion Radius",
    x = expression(N[s]),
    y = expression(r[d]~"(m)"),
    colour = "D"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ u_max, labeller = label_bquote(u[max] == .(u_max))) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_ratio <- ggplot(df_eu, aes(N_s, ratio, colour = D)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Relative Exploration Advantage",
    x = expression(N[s]),
    y = expression(e[u]^m / e[u]^r),
    colour = "D"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ u_max, labeller = label_bquote(u[max] == .(u_max))) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )


# --- 2x2 layout ---
(p_root | p_myco) /
(p_rd   | p_ratio)


```


## Plots, Crowding Saturation S(B_tot)

```{r}
# ===============================================================
# 1. N_s values and root ranges
# ===============================================================
root_d  <- root_diameter(l, traits) / 1000    # m
root_rho <- root_density(l, traits)           # kg m^-3
myco_d  <- myco_diameter                      # m
myco_rho <- myco_density                      # kg m^-3

N_s_vals  <- seq(0.1, 1, length.out = 10)           # soil N concentration
D_vals    <- 10^seq(-7, -3, length.out = 5)        # transport efficiency
u_max_vals <- c(0.44, 0.88, 1.32)                  # biochemical limits

n_vals <- seq(1e1, 1e7, length.out = 20)

# ===============================================================
# 2. Base biomass for roots only
# ===============================================================
df_n_base <- tibble(
  n = n_vals,
  l = 1.5
) %>%
  mutate(
    B_root = root_mass(l, n, 100, traits),
    root_d_mm = root_diameter(l, traits),
    rho_root = root_density(l, traits)
  )

# ===============================================================
# 3. Add S values for roots only (n-driven and l-driven)
# ===============================================================

df_n <- df_n_base %>%
  crossing(
    D     = D_vals,
    N_s   = N_s_vals,
    u_max = u_max_vals      # <-- add u_max here
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    S = S_crowding(
      B_root        = B_root,
      B_myco        = 0,
      root_d_mm     = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root      = rho_root,
      rho_myco      = myco_density,
      D             = D,
      N_s           = N_s,
      u_max         = u_max,   # <-- use u_max from crossing
      C_r           = 2,
      depth         = 0.5,
      k20           = k20,
      k21           = k21
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ===============================================================
# 4. Add mycorrhiza contributions
# ===============================================================

df_n_myco <- df_n %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_myco = B_root,
    S = S_crowding(
      B_root = B_root,
      B_myco = B_myco,
      root_d_mm = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root = rho_root,
      rho_myco = myco_density,
      D = D,
      N_s = N_s,
      u_max = u_c,
      C_r = 2,
      depth = 0.5,
      k20 = k20,
      k21 = k21
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ===============================================================
# 5. Prepare plotting data
# ===============================================================

df_combined_n <- bind_rows(
  df_n %>% mutate(myco = "no myco"),
  df_n_myco %>% mutate(myco = "myco")
)

# ===============================================================
# 6. Plots
# ===============================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# Ensure r_d is calculated
df_combined_n <- df_combined_n %>%
  mutate(r_d = D * N_s / u_max)

small_text_size <- 10  # smaller text

# -----------------------------
# 1. S vs r_d colored by N_s, no myco legend
# -----------------------------
# Shorten N_s labels and split legend into 2 columns
p_S_rd_Ns <- ggplot(df_combined_n %>% arrange(B_root, r_d),
                    aes(x = r_d, y = S, color = factor(round(N_s, 2)), shape = myco)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = c(color = TRUE, shape = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("no myco" = 16, "myco" = 4)) +  # circle & cross
  labs(title = "Crowding Saturation vs r_d",
       x = expression(r[d]~"(m)"),
       y = "S",
       color = expression(N[s]),
       shape = "Mycorrhiza") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"))

# -----------------------------
# 2. S vs r_d colored by D, no myco legend
# -----------------------------
p_S_rd_D <- ggplot(df_combined_n %>% arrange(B_root, r_d),
                   aes(x = r_d, y = S, color = factor(D), shape = myco)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = c(color = TRUE, shape = FALSE)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Soil diffusion effect",
       x = expression(r[d]~"(m)"),
       y = "S",
       color = "D") +
  theme_bw(base_size = small_text_size) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("no myco" = 16, "myco" = 4))

# -----------------------------
# 3. S vs r_d colored by u_max, no myco legend
# -----------------------------
p_S_rd_umax <- ggplot(df_combined_n %>% arrange(B_root, r_d),
                      aes(x = r_d, y = S, color = factor(u_max), shape = myco)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = c(color = TRUE, shape = FALSE)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Maximum uptake effect",
       x = expression(r[d]~"(m)"),
       y = "S",
       color = expression(u[max])) +
  theme_bw(base_size = small_text_size) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("no myco" = 16, "myco" = 4))

# -----------------------------
# 4. S vs r_d, only myco / no myco
# -----------------------------
p_S_rd_myco <- ggplot(df_combined_n %>% arrange(B_root, r_d),
                      aes(x = r_d, y = S, color = myco, shape = myco)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Mycorrhizal Effect",
       x = expression(r[d]~"(m)"),
       y = "S",
       color = "Mycorrhiza",
       shape = "Mycorrhiza") +
  theme_bw(base_size = small_text_size) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("no myco" = 16, "myco" = 4))

# -----------------------------
# Arrange in 2x2 grid
# -----------------------------
grid.arrange(p_S_rd_Ns, p_S_rd_D,
             p_S_rd_umax, p_S_rd_myco,
             ncol = 2)

# ========================================
# Crowding parameter sensitivity analysis
# ========================================

k21_vals <- seq(0.1, 1, length.out = 10)  # example low, medium, high

df_k21 <- df_n_base %>%
  crossing(k21 = k21_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    S = S_crowding(
      B_root        = B_root,
      B_myco        = B_root,
      root_d_mm     = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root      = rho_root,
      rho_myco      = myco_density,
      D             = 1e-4,    # fixed for simplicity
      N_s           = 1.5,     # fixed for simplicity
      u_max         = 0.88,    # fixed for simplicity
      C_r           = 2,
      depth         = 0.5,
      k20           = k20,
      k21           = k21
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(df_k21, aes(x = B_root, y = S, color = factor(k21))) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Crowding Saturation Sensitivity",
       x = "Root biomass (kg)",
       y = "S",
       color = expression(K[21])) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"))


```
## Uptake

```{r}
# df_n_base or df_n already has B_root, root_d_mm, rho_root
# We'll just use df_n_base here
df_basis <- df_n_base

B_myco_vals <- df_basis$B_root  # myco biomass = root biomass
N_s_vals    <- seq(0.1, 2.1, length.out = 11)
D_vals      <- 10^seq(-7, -3, length.out = 5)
u_max_vals  <- c(0.44, 0.88) # 1.32
k23_vals    <- c(1, 2, 4)[2]

df_uptake <- df_basis %>%
  crossing(
    myco = c("no myco", "myco"),   # new flag
    N_s  = N_s_vals,
    D    = D_vals,
    u_max = u_max_vals,
    k23   = k23_vals
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_myco_use = ifelse(myco == "myco", B_root, 0),  # 0 if no myco
    core = list(uptake_core(
      B_root        = B_root,
      B_myco        = B_myco_use,
      root_d_mm     = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root      = rho_root,
      rho_myco      = myco_density,
      D             = D,
      N_s           = N_s,
      u_max         = u_max,
      k21           = 0.5,
      k23           = 0.5
    )),
    U_root = core$U_root,
    U_myco = core$U_myco,
    Sval   = core$Sval,
    rd     = core$rd
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-core, -B_myco_use)

# Uptake vs N_s, roots only
p1 <- ggplot(df_uptake %>% filter(myco == "no myco"), 
       aes(x = N_s, y = U_root, color = factor(D))) +

  scale_y_continuous("Uptake (kg N / yr)") +

  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

# Uptake vs Root Biomass, roots only

       aes(x = B_root, y = U_root, color = N_s, size = D)) +

  scale_color_gradientn(colors = rainbow(7)) +

  scale_y_continuous("Uptake (kg N / yr)") +
  labs(title = "Root Uptake vs N_s",
       color = expression(N[s]),
       size = "D") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

p3 <- ggplot(df_uptake %>% filter(myco == "myco"), 
       aes(x = N_s, y = U_root, color = factor(D))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ u_max, labeller = label_bquote(u[max] == .(u_max))) +
  scale_y_continuous("Uptake (kg N / yr)") +
  labs(title = "Root Uptake vs N_s", color = "D") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

# Uptake vs Root Biomass, roots only
p4 <- ggplot(df_uptake %>% filter(myco == "myco"),
       aes(x = B_root, y = U_root, color = N_s, size = D)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = rainbow(7)) +

p3_rd <- ggplot(df_uptake %>% filter(myco == "myco"),
```

## Myco uptake

```{r}

df_uptake <- df_basis %>%
  crossing(
    root = c("no root", "root"),   # new flag
    N_s  = N_s_vals,
    D    = D_vals,
    u_max = u_max_vals,
    k23   = k23_vals
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_root_use = ifelse(root == "root", B_root, 0),  # 0 if no root,
    core = list(uptake_core(
      B_root        = B_root_use,
      B_myco        = B_root,
      root_d_mm     = root_d_mm,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      rho_root      = rho_root,
      rho_myco      = myco_density,
      D             = D,
      N_s           = N_s,
      u_max         = u_max,
      k21           = 0.5,
      k23           = 0.5
    )),
    U_root = core$U_root,
    U_myco = core$U_myco,
    Sval   = core$Sval,
    rd     = core$rd
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-core, -B_root_use)

# Uptake vs N_s, roots only
```

## Uptake

```{r}
# ===============================================================
# Parameters
# ===============================================================
u_max_fixed <- u_c
C_r <- 2
depth <- 0.5
investment_m <- 0.3
mycorrhized_fixed <- 0.9
N_s_vals <- seq(0.1, 2.1, length.out = 21)
n_vals <- seq(1e1, 1e7, length.out = 20)
l_vals <- seq(0.05, 2.0, length.out = 20)
D_fixed <- 1e-5   # example diffusion coefficient
crown_area_fixed <- 100
root_no_fixed <- 2.75e6
root_length_fixed <- 1.5
age_fixed <- 2

# ===============================================================
# 2. Plant uptake vs root biomass (varying N_s)
# ===============================================================
df_plant_u <- tidyr::crossing(
  root_no = n_vals,
  N_s = N_s_vals
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    B_root = root_mass(
      root_length_fixed,
      root_no,
      crown_area_fixed,
      traits
    ),
    U_plant = plant_uptake(
      N_s = N_s,
      crown_area = crown_area_fixed,
      root_length = root_length_fixed,
      root_no = root_no,
      traits = traits,
      mycorrhized = mycorrhized_fixed,
      investment_from_tree = investment_m,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      myco_density = myco_density,
      C_r = C_r,
      depth = depth,
      u_max = u_max_fixed,
      D = D_fixed
    )$N_total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ===============================================================
# 3. Plant uptake vs mycorrhizal biomass
# ===============================================================
investment_vals <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 20)

df_myco_u <- tidyr::crossing(
  investment_m = investment_vals,
  N_s = N_s_vals
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    U_plant = plant_uptake(
      N_s = N_s,
      crown_area = crown_area_fixed,
      root_length = root_length_fixed,
      root_no = root_no_fixed,
      traits = traits,
      mycorrhized = mycorrhized_fixed,
      investment_from_tree = investment_m,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      myco_density = myco_density,
      u_max = u_max_fixed,
      D = D_fixed
    )$N_total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ===============================================================
# 4. Plant uptake vs N_s
# ===============================================================
df_N_flux <- tibble(N_s = N_s_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    U_plant = plant_uptake(
      N_s = N_s,
      crown_area = crown_area_fixed,
      root_length = root_length_fixed,
      root_no = root_no_fixed,
      traits = traits,
      mycorrhized = mycorrhized_fixed,
      investment_from_tree = investment_m,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      myco_density = myco_density,
      u_max = u_max_fixed,
      D = D_fixed
    )$N_total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ===============================================================
# 5. Plant uptake vs age
# ===============================================================
df_age <- tibble(root_length = l_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    age = root_lifespan(root_length, traits),
    U_plant = plant_uptake(
      N_s = 0.1,
      crown_area = crown_area_fixed,
      root_length = root_length,
      root_no = root_no_fixed,
      traits = traits,
      mycorrhized = mycorrhized_fixed,
      investment_from_tree = investment_m,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      myco_density = myco_density,
      u_max = u_max_fixed,
      D = D_fixed
    )$N_total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ===============================================================
# 6. Plant uptake vs mycorrhized fraction
# ===============================================================
myco_frac <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 20)

df_myco_frac <- tibble(mycorrhized = myco_frac) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    U_plant = plant_uptake(
      N_s = 0.0001,
      crown_area = crown_area_fixed,
      root_length = root_length_fixed,
      root_no = root_no_fixed,
      traits = traits,
      mycorrhized = mycorrhized,
      investment_from_tree = investment_m,
      myco_diameter = myco_diameter,
      myco_density = myco_density,
      u_max = u_max_fixed,
      D = D_fixed
    )$N_total
  ) %>% ungroup()

# ======================
# Plots
# ======================

p_myco_frac <- ggplot(df_myco_frac, aes(mycorrhized, U_plant)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1, color = "forestgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Plant Uptake vs Mycorrhized Fraction",
    x = "Mycorrhized fraction",
    y = "Plant uptake (kg N)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_age <- ggplot(df_age, aes(age, U_plant)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1, color = "forestgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Plant Uptake vs Root Age",
    x = "Root age",
    y = "Plant uptake (kg N)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_Ns <- ggplot(df_N_flux, aes(N_s, U_plant)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1, color = "forestgreen") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = expression("Plant Uptake vs Soil N (" * N[s] * ")"),
    x = expression(N[s]~"(kg N m"^{-2}~"yr"^{-1}*")"),
    y = "Plant uptake (kg N)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

grid.arrange(
  p_myco_frac,
  p_age,
  p_Ns,
  ncol = 2
)


```
